tools.name: list_scheduled_posts
tools.description: List posts scheduled or drafted for a connected account in a date range.

tools.name: get_post_analytics
tools.description: Fetch reach, likes, comments and clicks for a published post.

tools.name: create_post_draft
tools.description: Save a new draft post for a connected account.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule an existing draft to publish at a given time.

tools.name: publish_post_now
tools.description: Publish a draft immediately to its account.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Permanently delete a draft, scheduled or published post.

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Post a public reply to a comment on one of the accounts' posts.

tools.name: hide_comment
tools.description: Hide a comment from public view on a post.

tools.name: send_report_email
tools.description: Send an email with a performance report or note to a recipient.

tools.name: post_to_team_channel
tools.description: Post a message to an internal team channel.

tools.name: change_member_role
tools.description: Change the workspace role of a team member (viewer, editor, admin).

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.description: Disconnect a social account from the workspace.
